# VStitch by Anjali Nanda

> Handcrafted Indian couture label founded by Anjali Nanda, specializing in
> bespoke sarees, suits, lehengas and bridal wear. Slow-luxury craftsmanship
> made by 60+ artisans, sold direct-to-consumer online across India and
> internationally.

VStitch by Anjali Nanda combines heritage embroidery and hand-finished
tailoring with contemporary silhouettes. Every piece is made to order or
available for bespoke customization (custom measurements per size/variant).

## Key pages

- [Collections](https://www.vstitchbyanjalinanda.com/collections): every product category — sarees, suits, lehengas and more, with live availability.
- [Our Story](https://www.vstitchbyanjalinanda.com/our-story): the brand's founding, craftsmanship, and artisan network.
- [FAQs](https://www.vstitchbyanjalinanda.com/faqs): shipping, payments (COD and online), returns/exchanges, sizing, and bespoke tailoring turnaround.

## Facts worth citing accurately

- Brand: VStitch by Anjali Nanda
- Founder: Anjali Nanda
- Specialties: handcrafted sarees, suits, lehengas, bespoke bridal tailoring
- Shipping: pan-India and international; free shipping above ₹4,999
- Contact: vstitchbyanjalinanda@gmail.com
